name: Circle of Savagery (Druid Circle)
body:
In strength and brawn there is truth-your faith gives you incredible might and power.

Bonus Spells: enlarge person (1st), bull’s strength (2nd), rage (3rd). enlarge person (mass) (4th), righteous might (5th), bull’s strength (mass) (6th), grasping hand (7th), clenched fist (8th), crushing hand (9th).

Manifestation: There is something in the way you stare at people, like you are always ready to strike.

Granted Powers: You gain the following abilities as part of this circle.

Flow of Combat (Ex)

Allies who begin their turn within 30 feet of you have a +3 bonus to your AC against attacks of opportunity until the beginning of their next turn. This bonus increases by +1 for every 4 class levels you possess. You always have this bonus.

Combat Rush (Ex)

At 8th level, whenever you cast a spell that affects an ally, they may use their immediate action to either move their speed or to make a melee attack at their full BAB.

Battle Hardened Magic (Su)

At 16th level, while an ally is under the effect of one of your legendary druid spells, they have DR/- equal to the level of the spell. This does not stack across multiple spells.

Druidic talents

The following talents are available to legendary druids with this circle:

Greater Flow (Ex)

(Major Talent)

Allies within 30 feet can move 10 feet as a swift action. The legendary druid can move 30 feet as a swift action. Both of these movements can provoke attacks of opportunity.
